notes.title: Aleprok 2.24.35: The Volcano & Beyond Update - Massive Content Drop!
notes.notes:
What's New in The Volcano & Beyond Update?Vast New Worlds & Epic Dungeons Await!
Embark on grand adventures across entirely new territories and challenging special maps:

The Volcano: Discover a brand-new Discovery map teeming with perils and opportunities, featuring 5 unique defensive maps within its fiery depths.

Story Mode & More: Uncover untold tales in the new Story Mode dungeon, "Forgotten Islands," located in the Winter map.

Specialized Challenges: Test your mettle in the new Tower Defense dungeon, "Forge," on the Forest map, and face off in the Elimination dungeon, "Desert," on the Dead Plains map.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475307/626816ef0bf956934400c833517372ef840e6799.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475307/1129793b12c636a8624246b925aaa2e1a0776411.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475307/9cd5d1a813be417785773cd3657dadfaac4e0ac8.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475307/9fe86a5c6bed7cbb3fba4dc0f12d888f85b44a4a.png"]

The Final Boss: Confront the ultimate challenge in the Elimination dungeon, "Final Boss," within the Volcano map.

Arena 5: Prove your combat prowess in the latest addition to the Arenas!
Unleash New Power: Weapons, Units & Skills!
Arm your clan with an expanded arsenal and command powerful new allies and abilities:

Advanced Weapon Forms: Unlock Form 8 for your Sword, Axe, Pickaxe, Spear, and Shield, bringing unparalleled power and visual upgrades.

Evolved Wands: Harness new magic with Forms 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8 for Wizard Wand.

New Foes & Allies: Confront the cunning Sphere Robot and the mighty Dwarf King. Beware the Fire Fox and unpredictable Undead Knight.

Deadly Traps: Fortify your defences with the potent new Fire Trap.

Master New Skills: Devastate your enemies with the brand-new active skill, Circle of Death. The Thunderbolt Skill has also been completely reworked to chain damage more effectively!

Empowered Projectiles: Wield the Magic Ball Strong as a new wand projectile and harness the new Empowering effect projectile.

Resource Rarity: Discover and utilize the valuable new Crystal resource, found exclusively in the Volcano map.
Deep System Revisions & Quality of Life Enhancements!
We've meticulously refined core gameplay mechanics and implemented crucial quality-of-life improvements:

Eco-Friendly Building: Get 99% of resources back when destroying buildings (up from 95%), encouraging more strategic base adjustments.

Optimized Game Management: Disabled NPC movement and spawning after game end for cleaner session transitions.

Fairer Combat: Friendly fire has been removed from most explosive effects, attacks(up to 80%), skills, and projectiles, allowing for more coordinated tactics.

Skill Balancing: Numerous skill stats have been rebalanced, including a reduced mana cost for Electric Skill (8 to 6), modified Regeneration and more.

Dynamic Environments: Experience the world like never before with weather added to the game!

Refined Town Hall: The Town Hall laser system has been completely reworked, and Town Hall Form 7 has been added. Plus, a new button allows you to destroy your Town Hall when needed.

Improved UI: Enjoy increased readability for resource notifications.

Personalized Loadouts: Your weapon effects and projectiles setup are now saved, so you can jump right back into the action with your preferred configuration.

New Player Onboarding: New players will now be prompted to start a tutorial, making it easier to jump into Aleprok's world.
Crucial Fixes & Performance Boosts!
We've squashed numerous bugs and significantly optimized performance for a smoother experience:

Major Performance Gains: Significant CPU performance improvements for traps and overall performance fixes, including fps drops in the main menu.

Stability & Saving: Critical fix for a bug where incompatible operating system cultures could corrupt clan databases, ensuring your progress is safe!

Visual Fidelity: Fixed incorrect turret rotations, Town Hall form 6 lagging/visual bugs, and wrong text visualizations.

Combat Precision: Addressed bugs where units on different height levels couldn't see each other and fixed the shield equipping bug on Warriors.

Reworked Physics: Improved the behaviour of physics forces throughout the game.

Localization Complete: Enjoy a fully translated and localized experience!

Unity Upgrade: We've migrated Aleprok to the latest long-term supported Unity 2022 version, paving the way for future stability and advancements.

Security update: Added security headers to Home page Aleprok.
Beyond the Battlefield: Cosmetic & Achievements!
New Player Skin: Customize your look with a new player skin that also provides a +20% mana regeneration bonus!

Steam Achievements: Conquer new challenges and earn prestigious Steam achievements like: Elder Dragon Slayer; Fire, blood and three tails?; Even robots now? Really?; De-Knighted; My Throne Now, Little Guy.

Version 1.23.20

Update Highlights:
🏗️ Clan Buildings Upgrade

notes.title: Update v1.23.19
notes.notes:
Version 1.23.19
This update introduces several changes and fixes aimed at improving the overall experience. Here’s a detailed overview:

Changes:

 Reduced damage to friendly units by 80%.
 All skins and visuals now grant specific bonuses to players.
 Titles have been added for players, determined by their level.
 Zombie Balancing:
[olist]
 Hit points increased from 65 to 85.
 Speed increased from 1.75 to 1.85.
 Armor increased from 5 to 7.
[/olist]
 Strong Zombie Balancing:
[olist]
 Hit points increased from 80 to 105.
 Speed increased from 2 to 2.1.
 Armor increased from 15 to 17.
[/olist]
 Wall prices adjusted for levels 3, 4, 5, and 6.
 Town Hall Level 2: Gold price reduced from 7000 to 6500.
 Other changes:
[olist]
 Slightly improved code performance
 Tree resource capacity increased on Dead and Winter maps.
 Stone resource capacity increased on Winter map.
[/olist]

Fixes:

 Fixed a bug where repairing the Town Hall could count multiple hits instead of one, causing it to be repaired 2-3 times instead of just once.
 Localization fixes: "Find chest and obtain reward"
 Fixed issue in Temple Dungeon.
 Fixed a bug where units were sometimes unable to obtain weapons from the Armory.
 Fix for vortex stacking range bug.

notes.title: Patch v1.22.18
notes.notes:
Version 1.22.18
This patch introduces several updates and fixes aimed at improving the overall experience. Here’s a detailed overview:

Changes:

 Town Hall Level 3: Gold price reduced from 9000 to 8500.
 Human Companions: Adjusted damage scaling to 5%.
 Wizard Tower: 
[olist]
 Damage increased across all levels.
 Unlock progression updated: Level 2 now unlocks at the Spider Nest, and Level 3 unlocks at the Graveyard.
 Minor adjustment to shooting mechanics.
[/olist]
 Cannon: Minor adjustment to shooting mechanics.
 Blizzard Effect: Enemies hit by Town Hall blizzards are slowed by 20% in both movement and attack speed for the duration of the blizzard, plus an additional 3 seconds.
 Frost Resistance Adjustments:
[olist]
 Spider: Frost resistance changed from 0% to -10%.
 Giant Spider: Frost resistance changed from 0% to -20%.
[/olist]
 Bear Balancing:
[olist]
 Hit points decreased from 200 to 180.
 Defense reduced from 25 to 20.
 Damage lowered from 7.5 to 6.5.
[/olist]
 Other changes:
[olist]
 Deactivated friendly fire on buildings.
 Notifications added for new buildings unlocked by player levels and XP/resource gains from completed defense levels.
 Forest Level 5: Reduced bear count in the final wave from 3 to 1.
 Tutorial now uses instant notifications when new quests appear.
 Audio settings updated to include volume sliders.
[/olist]


Fixes:

 Resolved minimap bug affecting 4K+ resolutions.
 Localization fixes
[olist]
 Close button in Wizard UI.
 Confirm button in Shield Upgrader UI.
[/olist]
 Fixed issue in Temple Dungeon.

notes.title: Patch v1.21.17
notes.notes:
Version 1.21.17
This patch introduces several updates and fixes aimed at improving the overall experience. Here’s a detailed overview:

Changes:
 - Updated the tutorial for a smoother onboarding experience.
 - Added teleports directly to specific tasks on the first map.
 - Scaling hitpoints of players per level adjusted from 2 to 1.7.
 - Companion first form spawn time reduced from 60 to 40 seconds.
 - Town Hall build time reduced from 60 to 15 seconds.
 - Barrack and Armory build time reduced from 60 to 45 seconds.
 - Build menu now auto-hides when a building is selected for build.
 - Added wiki buttons for Companion upgrades and Player Level points.

Fixes:
 - Fixed an issue causing errors when saving progress during tutorial exit.
 - Resolved notifications getting stuck behind one another.
 - Fixed a bug preventing the in-game menu from showing.
 - Corrected the positioning of some UI elements.
